confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from 2026 travel and cost-of-living guides with mixed dates and methods, so restaurant and coffee are moderately supported and beer and wine are weaker. Cocktail and wine were anchored on guide ranges and checked against the local beer price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Melbourne hotel tiers; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. FX: I could not retrieve the latest RBA daily observation. The rate used is the most recent official RBA value I located (20 March 2026), so it is stale against the 2026-11-19 generation date and may differ materially from the current rate. A third-party October 2026 figure was not used because it is not an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Melbourne-specific basis. Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors are based on 2026 Melbourne cost-of-living and menu-price guides, cross-checked against Australian national café and pub data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for Melbourne CBD and inner-city tiers for July 2026 (winter, moderate demand).
